notes:
Account background: Meadowgate builds a mid-market ITSM product focused on SMB/Mid-market customers. Primary interest is replacing slow internal helpdesk flows with an assistant that can route, triage, and take immediate actions (create/triage Jira tickets, surface KB answers) via tool-calls. Evaluating Hosted API as quick path; want Dedicated for production after POC.

POC scope (agreed):
- Two flows: 1) streaming chat agent with tool-calls to Jira + internal ticket DB; 2) embeddings-backed KB retrieval for triage.
- Latency targets: p95 end-to-end typing latency <200-250ms for agent responses in streaming mode; p99 needs to be explained for 99th percentile.
- Throughput goal: sustain ~600 concurrent active sessions during peak; typical baseline 150-250.
- Model preferences: pref open-chat models with lower cost quantized variants for throughput; fallback policy to smaller model for burst.
- Observability: token-level cost breakdown, per-route latency SLA, trace for tool-call failures.
- Security: SSO/SAML with SCIM, SOC2 evidence required, audit logs retention 3 years, key management (KMS integration), US data residency.
